================================================================================
HOW MLM MASKING WORKS: WHAT THE MODEL KNOWS VS DOESN'T KNOW
================================================================================

ORIGINAL SEQUENCE:
┌─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┐
│push │ rbp │ mov │ rbp │ rsp │ lea │ rbp │
└─────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴─────┘

AFTER MASKING (15% selected):
┌─────┬───────┬─────┬───────┬─────┬─────┬─────┐
│push │[MASK] │ mov │movsq  │ rsp │ lea │ rbp │  ← MODEL INPUT
└─────┴───────┴─────┴───────┴─────┴─────┴─────┘
         ▲              ▲                    ▲
         │              │                    │
       [MASK]        random              kept original
        80%            10%                  10%

LABELS (what to predict):
┌──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┐
│ -100 │ 535  │ -100 │ 535  │ -100 │ -100 │ 535  │  ← LOSS LABELS
└──────┴──────┴──────┴──────┴──────┴──────┴──────┘
          ▼              ▼                    ▼
       compute        compute             compute
        loss           loss                loss


================================================================================
WHAT THE MODEL SEES (FORWARD PASS)
================================================================================

Input IDs:  [530, 4, 522, 2859, 520, 551, 535]
            (push, [MASK], mov, movsq, rsp, lea, rbp)

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                 │
│        TRANSFORMER MODEL (12 layers)            │
│                                                 │
│  Processes ALL tokens                           │
│  Outputs predictions for ALL positions          │
│  Does NOT know which are masked!                │
│                                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
    Model Output: [pred_0, pred_1, pred_2, ..., pred_6]
                   (2902-dim probability vectors)


================================================================================
WHAT THE LOSS FUNCTION SEES
================================================================================

MLM Labels: [-100, 535, -100, 535, -100, -100, 535]

CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=-100):

Position 0: input='push'   label=-100  → IGNORE (no gradient)
Position 1: input='[MASK]' label=535   → COMPUTE LOSS, predict 'rbp'
Position 2: input='mov'    label=-100  → IGNORE
Position 3: input='movsq'  label=535   → COMPUTE LOSS, predict 'rbp'
Position 4: input='rsp'    label=-100  → IGNORE
Position 5: input='lea'    label=-100  → IGNORE
Position 6: input='rbp'    label=535   → COMPUTE LOSS, predict 'rbp'
                                          (even though input==label!)

Total Loss = (loss_pos1 + loss_pos3 + loss_pos6) / 3


================================================================================
WHY THE MODEL CAN'T TELL WHICH IS WHICH
================================================================================

Case 1: [MASK] token (80%)
  Input: [MASK] (ID 4)
  Model sees: Special token, needs to predict from context
  Model doesn't know: "This was originally 'rbp'"

Case 2: Random token (10%)
  Input: movsq (ID 2859)
  Model sees: Regular token 'movsq'
  Model doesn't know: "This is wrong, should be 'rbp'"
  Model must learn: From context, this should be 'rbp' not 'movsq'

Case 3: Keep original (10%)
  Input: rbp (ID 535)
  Label: rbp (ID 535)
  Model sees: Regular token 'rbp'
  Model doesn't know: "This is a masked position" vs "This is unmasked"
  Model must learn: Always output good representations


================================================================================
TRAINING DYNAMICS
================================================================================

Step 1: Forward Pass
  • Model processes ALL tokens
  • Generates predictions for ALL positions
  • Time: O(sequence_length)

Step 2: Loss Computation
  • Only positions with label != -100 contribute to loss
  • In your example: 3 out of 7 positions
  • Loss = average of these 3 positions

Step 3: Backward Pass
  • Gradients ONLY flow from masked positions
  • Model learns to predict masked tokens from context
  • Unmasked positions get NO gradient signal for MLM task


================================================================================
INFERENCE (AFTER TRAINING)
================================================================================

Input: [push, rbp, mov, rbp, rsp, lea, rbp]  ← No [MASK] tokens!

Model:
  • Processes normally (no masking)
  • Outputs embeddings for all tokens
  • Works because it learned to handle real tokens (10% + random)


================================================================================
KEY TAKEAWAYS
================================================================================

✓ Model sees ALL tokens (masked and unmasked) in input
✓ Model predicts ALL positions in forward pass
✓ Loss computed ONLY at masked positions (label != -100)
✓ Gradients ONLY flow from masked positions
✗ Model does NOT know which positions are masked
✗ Model does NOT know which tokens are original vs [MASK] vs random
✗ Model does NOT have special "masking indicator" input

This design ensures:
  1. Model learns from context (not from [MASK] indicator)
  2. Model handles real tokens (10% + random)
  3. Model works at inference (no [MASK] tokens)
  4. Model doesn't overfit to [MASK] → token pattern


================================================================================
YOUR DATALOADER OUTPUT STRUCTURE
================================================================================

return {
    'input_ids': [530, 4, 522, 2859, 520, 551, 535],  # What model sees
    'attention_mask': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],          # All valid tokens
    'mlm_labels': [-100, 535, -100, 535, -100, -100, 535],  # Loss targets
    'jtp_labels': [-100, -100, -100, -100, -100, -100, -100]  # Jump targets
}

Model never sees mlm_labels during forward pass!
Labels only used in loss computation.
